gst.read_failure.server: Server in GST records ko read nahi kar saka. Ek baar dobara try karein; agar phir bhi dikkat aaye, toh backend par dhyan dene ki zaroorat hai. Aapke save kiye gaye records mein koi badlav nahi hua hai.
gst.read_failure.connection: In records ko load karne ke liye connect nahi ho saka. Apna connection check karein aur phir se try karein.
gst.health_unbalanced: Unbalanced net aur tax ke saath sales
gst.health_limited: Yeh report latest 1,000 documents aur 100 invoice blocks ko cover karti hai. Purane records ke liye alag se review ki zaroorat hogi.

gst.device_revoke_failed: Result confirm nahi ho saka. Phir se try karne se pehle installations refresh karein; ho sakta hai revocation pehle hi save ho chuka ho.
gst.health_number_notice: Unconfirmed numbers offline nikle invoices ke ho sakte hain. Inhe dobara istemal na karein ya wapas claim na karein. Pehle invoices nikalne wale devices aur pending sales ko mila lein.

gst.error.gst_capability_refresh_require: GST document issue karne se pehle supported app ke saath billing settings connect aur refresh karein.

gst.error.provision_failed: Invoice number reserve nahi ho paye. Internet se connect karein, phir billing setup refresh karein aur retry karein. Aapka cart aur saved bills surakshit hain.

gst.error.settlement_reversal_reason_req: Is entry ko theek karne ke liye ek reason add karein.

gst.error.purchase_stock_choice_required: Har line ke liye stock receive karna hai ya nahi, yeh choose karein.

gst.error.itc_review_evidence_required: Review note aur supporting evidence enter karein.

gst.error.invalid_product_tax: Har product ka reviewed HSN/SAC, category aur GST rate check karein.
gst.error.interstate_supply_not_supporte: Interstate billing abhi supported nahi hai.

gst.review_confirm: Main is dukaan ke GST registration aur billing details ko confirm karta hoon. Inhein sahi rakhne ki zimmedari meri hai.

gst.core_transfer_notice: Review ke liye is dukaan ki product settings export karein, phir import ke liye prati 100 confirmed products tak select karein. Dukaan ke classifications aur rates uski apni property hain; external advice optional hai. Missing settings select nahi ki ja sakti. CSV columns aur text prefixes ko waise hi rakhein. Issue kiye gaye invoices bina badle rahenge.
gst.export_range_title: Date range ke liye sales register
gst.export_range_notice: Dates Indian Standard Time mein hain. Start date ko include karein; end date se pehle rok dein. Sirf preparation—kuch bhi file nahi kiya jata.
gst.export_range_invalid: Valid YYYY-MM-DD dates enter karein jisme end date start date ke baad ho.
gst.core_export_title: Baahri filing ke liye file taiyar karein
gst.core_export_notice: Ye rakhe gaye reports hain, submit kiye gaye returns nahi. Export ya download karne se IRP ke saath documents file, approve ya authorize nahi hote, aur e-way bill bhi issue nahi hota. Apne baahri filing process mein files istemal karne se pehle period, source records aur reconciliation issues check kar lein.
gst.core_scope: Sirf standard same-state counter billing. Walk-in buyers ke liye mixed taxable/exempt bills supported hain, GST-registered buyers ke liye nahi. Interstate, cess, special valuation, reverse charge, export/SEZ aur delivery arrangements unsupported hain. Reports kahin aur file karne ke liye file taiyar karti hain; yeh app returns file nahi karta ya IRP/e-way documents issue nahi karta.
gst.scope: Local counter billing. Product classification aur rates check karne honge; special supplies aur government filing supported nahi hain.
gst.active_profile: GST active hai. Legal registration badalne ke liye support review ki zaroorat hoti hai taaki purane bills aur offline devices consistent rahein.

gst.recovery_notice: Ye current shop aur issuing account ke liye is device par rakhe gaye bills hain. Recovery inka original number aur payment details rakhti hai. Ye screen server synchronization ya GST filing confirm nahi karti.
